headline: Your website is secure and running smoothly.
summary: In July we applied six security patches, made sure every enquiry reaches both inboxes and made the contact page load faster.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Security patches applied
improvements.body: Six patches were applied the week they were released, with no downtime.

improvements.title: Every enquiry reaches both inboxes
improvements.body: Some enquiries only reached one inbox. Every form now reaches both.

improvements.title: Contact page loads faster
improvements.body: The form's spam check now loads after the page, saving 0.6 seconds.

improvements.title: Uptime held at 100%
improvements.body: The site stayed online all month, confirmed by checks every five minutes.

nextMonth: Clean up unused code and old branches
